report.title: tel: and sms: URI schemes not supported in links.
report.body: ### Check before submitting - [x] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate ### Describe the bug Markdown links using the `tel:` and `sms:` URI schemes do not render correctly. ### Steps to reproduce Write the following markdown in a memo: ``` [phone me](tel:+440000000000) ``` I'd expect this to render as something like: ``` phone me ``` But it renders as ``` phone me ``` The same bug also affects the `sms:` URI scheme. ### Memos version v0.31.0-rc.1 ### Additional context _No response_

steps: Open the memo editor to create a new memo
Type `[phone me](tel:+440000000000)` into the memo editor
Click the Save button to create the memo
Locate the saved memo in the memo list and look at the rendered 'phone me' link
plan.expected: the rendered memo shows a 'phone me' link that is a clickable anchor with href 'tel:+440000000000'
plan.reported_actual: The link renders as an anchor without an href (phone me), so the tel: link is not functional. The same happens with the sms: scheme.
missing: assumed: the markdown is entered as the memo body in the standard memo editor on the home page and saved as a new memo
The exact sms: link example was not given, so only the tel: example is reproduced
assumed: inspecting the rendered link's href attribute is possible to verify the bug
plan.summary: Markdown links with tel: and sms: URI schemes render as anchors without href in memos
